3M / Solventum.note: 3M spun off its healthcare business division as an independent corporate entity named Solventum Corporation in 2024.

Aquila Healthcare Limited.note: Aquila Healthcare Limited was established in 2020 as part of Aquila Group Holdings and there is no record of it being acquired by another company.

BioChange Ltd..note: BioChange Ltd. is a privately held regenerative medicine company founded in 2017 and continues to operate independently under its original name.

EVOMEDIS GmbH.note: EVOMEDIS GmbH operates as an independent company and a spin-off from QRSKIN, specializing in novel wound therapies.

Maxigen Biotech Inc..note: TCI Co., Ltd. acquired a majority controlling stake in Maxigen Biotech Inc. in July 2021.

PT Conkote Medical Indonesia.note: PT Conkote Medical Indonesia operates as a subsidiary under its parent company Zhejiang Hongyu Group.

AQMEN MEDTECH.note: Aqmen Medtech Private Limited operates as an independent private limited manufacturing company based in India.

Dadeh Gostaran Dena Pjs..note: Dadeh Gostaran Dena (DG Dena) is an active, independent medical manufacturer operating in Iran.

Lokus Medical (M) Sdn Bhd.note: Lokus Medical (M) Sdn Bhd is an independent advanced wound care technology provider operating in Malaysia.
